Name: METER_ODO
Data:
0.1~1609346.0：Meter 
transmission ODO value
Even if ODO is over 1609346.0, this is sent 1609346.0.
FFFFFFFF：Meter
transmission at ERROR

Name: METER_SPEED
Data:
0.01～655.34：Meter 
transmission vehicle speed
655.35(FFFF)：Meter
transmission at ERROR

Name: METER_GRIP_HEATER_LEVEL
Data:
0:GRIP HEATER OFF
1:GRIP HEATER LEVEL1
2:GRIP HEATER LEVEL2
3:GRIP HEATER LEVEL3
4:GRIP HEATER LEVEL4
5:GRIP HEATER LEVEL5
6:Fail

Name: METER_TRIPA_AUTO_RESET

Name: IVI_BACKGROUND
Data: 0:White, 1: Black

Name: TCU_TRACKING_ON
Data:
0: TCU tracking function is disabled.
1: TCU tracking functions is enabled.

Name: TCU_STOPPED_ID
Data:
0: TCU tracking is not disabled due to ID mismatch.
1: TCU tracking is disabled due to ID mismatch.

Name: TCU_STOPPED_FORCE
Data:
0: TCU tracking is not disabled due to force stop command from IVI.
1: TCU tracking is disabled due to force stop command from IVI.

Name: TCU_STOPPED_ERR
Data:
0: TCU tracking is not disabled due to some error occurd in TCU.
1: TCU tracking is disabled due to some error occurd in TCU.

Name: TCU_INITIALIZING
Data:
0: TCU is not in the initializing process, or initialization is completed.
1: TCU is initializing.

Name: TCU_MEMORY_ERASING
Data:
0: TCU is not in the erasing memory process, or its internal memory is erased with the command from IVI.
1: TCU is not in the erasing memory process.

Name: TCU_RESTARTING
Data:
0: TCU is not in the restarting process, or TCU firmware is restarted with the command from IVI.
1: TCU is in the restarting process

Name: TCU_NETWORK_CONDITION
Data:
0: TCU is not connected to server.
1: TCU is connected to server.

Name: TCU_GPS_CONDITION
Data:
0: GPS of TCU is not available.
1: GPS of TCU is available.

Name: TCU_ERR
Data:
0: TCU does not have any DTC.
1: TCU has any DTC.

Name: IVI_ID_FROM_TCU
Data:
The stored IVI ID in TCU
0: Invalid ID
From 1 to 2^42-1: Valid ID

Name: TCU_ID_FROM_TCU
Data:
The stored TCU ID in TCU

From 1 to 2^7^8-1: Valid ID

Name: TCU_ID_INVALIDATED
Data:
0: The combination of TCU ID and IVI ID is correct.
1: The combination of TCU ID and IVI ID is mismatch.

Name: TCU_RESTART_CMD
